name: Vortex-Net
definition: A CNN trained to replicate the classification boundary of the Instantaneous Vorticity Deviation (IVD) criterion for vortex identification in volumetric data, avoiding manual threshold selection.
summary: Vortex-Net identifies vortices in volumetric flow data by training a CNN to replicate the Instantaneous Vorticity Deviation criterion, offering high accuracy and significant speedup over direct computation.
